## Validation

## Risk review

- [ ] Security impact considered; no secrets or sensitive report details included

- [ ] Workflow permissions remain least-privilege and actions remain pinned to full SHAs

- [ ] Architecture, threat model, governance, or release docs updated where affected
- [ ] Breaking change is explicitly marked
